profile.does: A ride app for getting around town. Riders request a car in two taps; drivers go online when they want and keep more of each fare.
profile.why: Fair, steady prices for riders, and drivers keep 80% of every fare.

audience.who: People in US cities who take a ride a few times a month, and people who want to earn on their own hours by driving.
audience.lifestyle: Commuters, students, nights out, side jobs

product.free_limits: Free to join and check prices

money.free: Joining, checking prices and wait times
money.paid: Riders pay each fare, about $14 a ride in town; drivers keep 80%

ads.line: About $14 a ride around town. No surprise surge.

competition.now: The big ride apps, with prices that jump at busy hours and drivers who keep less of each fare.
competition.switch: Hopway shows one fair price up front, and drivers keep more, so more of them stay online.

retention.back: A note when a car is close by at the time you usually ride.
retention.leave: Long waits because few drivers are online, or a driver screen with no requests.

a.changes: Austin, Denver and Nashville at once; riders and drivers together

b.changes: Austin, then Denver on day 45; drivers first at local events, rider ads from day 14

meta.note: Simulated, calibrated to public benchmarks. Not observed.

verdict.headline: Plan B wins.
verdict.reason: By focusing spending in fewer places and recruiting drivers before riders, Plan B had enough drivers nearby when riders arrived, turning fewer sign-ups into more rides. Plan B won 22 of 30 runs.

story.persona: You are 26 and you often need a ride home after dinners, shows, or drinks with friends. You hate it when your usual apps raise prices at busy hours, so a clear $14 price gets your eye right away. You will install a new app faster than most people if your friends are with you, but you worry there will be no cars late at night when you need one most. You can wait with friends for a while, yet you will drop the app if your first late ride leaves you standing outside. You sometimes need a ride around town. You work as a restaurant worker.
